Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class NotificationService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.NotificationService

  • Constructor Details

    • NotificationService

      public NotificationService(UserRepository users, NotificationRepository notifications, UserRole role)
      Creates a portal-scoped notification service.

      The role is the portal allowed to use this instance; every inbox operation requires an active account with exactly that role.

      Parameters:
      users - the account repository used to authorise the recipient
      notifications - the notification repository
      role - the portal role allowed to use this instance
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null

  • Method Details

    • getNotifications

      public List<Notification> getNotifications(User recipient, boolean includeRead) throws SQLException
      Returns the signed-in recipient's notifications, newest first.

      The recipient's stored account must be active and have the role this service was created for; the inbox is then scoped to that account's username.

      Parameters:
      recipient - the signed-in account
      includeRead - true to include read history, false for unread notifications only
      Returns:
      the matching notifications
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the account is missing, inactive, has the wrong role, or has no username
      SQLException - if the account or notification query fails

    • markAsRead

      public boolean markAsRead(User recipient, String notificationId) throws SQLException
      Marks one notification as read when it belongs to the signed-in recipient.

      The update is scoped by both notification id and recipient username, so one portal cannot mark another account's notification.

      Parameters:
      recipient - the signed-in account
      notificationId - the notification identifier
      Returns:
      true when an unread notification owned by the recipient was marked read; false when it does not exist, is already read, or belongs to another account
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the account is not an active account for this portal, or the notification id is blank
      SQLException - if the account lookup or update fails

    • markAllAsRead

      public int markAllAsRead(User recipient) throws SQLException
      Marks every unread notification of the signed-in recipient as read.
      Parameters:
      recipient - the signed-in account
      Returns:
      the number of notifications that were changed
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the account is not an active account for this portal
      SQLException - if the account lookup or update fails
